newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea intervenes at 875.00 won - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea intervenes at 875.00 won - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) sold dollars at 875.00 won early Friday morning to limit a sharp fall in the local currency, dealers said.
Dealers said the BOK placed dollar selling orders at the 875.00 won level even before the opening bell.
A BOK official said the central bank would neither confirm nor deny its intervention.
The won rose to 874.70 after the intervention. It opened at 875.00, the new 84-month low level.
Dealers said many banks would remain cautious throughout the day, preventing the dollar from rising over 875.00.
